title: Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Creative Arts; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Clay work on boards; dry pieces slowly in the shade.

skills.key_step: The child orders the slab method: wedge, roll an even slab with guide sticks, cut pieces, score and join with slip, decorate, dry slowly.

floor.question: What joins two pieces of clay?

steps: Cut, score and join with slip.

board.do: Write the steps out of order.

misconceptions.ask: What is a slab in pottery?
misconceptions.repair: Roll a ball of clay flat with a rolling pin.

misconceptions.ask: How do you join two slabs?
misconceptions.repair: Join two pieces dry and then scored with slip, and compare.

misconceptions.ask: How should a clay item be dried?
misconceptions.repair: Dry two small tiles, one fast and one slow, and look for cracks.

misconceptions.ask: Why use two guide sticks when rolling a slab?
misconceptions.repair: Roll with guide sticks and cut to show even thickness.

checks.question: Why are edges scored before joining?
checks.answer: so the slip grips and the join holds
